interest: Grew's role in founding the International Christian University.
overview: This file consists of correspondence from November 1949 between former U.S. Ambassador to Japan Joseph C. Grew and Assistant Secretary of State for Far Eastern Affairs W. Walton Butterworth regarding the establishment and promotion of the International Christian University (ICU) in Mitaka, Japan. Grew provides a draft of an open Christmas and New Year letter intended for publication in the journal Contemporary Japan, published by the Foreign Affairs Association of Japan, requesting State Department review for any undesirable content. In the open letter, Grew discusses the North American fundraising campaign he chaired, cites an endorsement from Fleet Admiral Chester W. Nimitz, and details the university's academic structure and democratic mission under President Hachiro Yuasa and Vice-President Maurice E. Troyer ahead of its planned April 1951 opening. Butterworth confirms departmental clearance and congratulates Grew on his work, followed by a brief internal Department of State routing note.
